description: This file contains multiple shell functions related to managing pull request workflows, particularly for merge verification, checking drift, and automating merges in a GitHub environment. It includes functions for detecting critical paths, verifying pull request status, and performing automated merge procedures with comments.

methods.name: is_mainline_drift_critical_path_for_merge
methods.description: Determines if the given file path is part of the mainline drift critical path relevant for merge operations.

methods.name: print_file_list_with_limit
methods.description: Outputs a limited number of lines from a specified file, with a label and line count.

methods.name: mainline_drift_requires_sync
methods.description: Checks if mainline drift requires synchronization before a merge, based on overlapping or critical infrastructure files.

methods.name: merge_verify
methods.description: Performs validation checks to confirm that a pull request is ready to be merged, including checks on PR status, required checks, and drift relevance.

methods.name: merge_run
methods.description: Coordinates the merge process for a pull request including pre-merge checks, merging with proper author attribution, posting comments, and cleanup.
